payload.summary: Keep Encephalon dogfooding state visible to Git.
lessons: Do not ignore the repository's root encephalon directory wholesale in projects that dogfood Encephalon; records and referenced artifacts are durable project memory and should be ordinary reviewable Git changes.
If local scratch state needs ignoring, ignore only the transient internal path, such as encephalon/_staging, so future memory records do not require git add -f.
verification: After changing Encephalon state, run git status without force-add assumptions and confirm new records appear as ordinary untracked or staged files.

searchText: Encephalon dogfooding gitignore state records visible git staging
subject: workflow.gitignore-dogfooding
